title: GOAL: run unattended: ship finished goals to main with rollback, file the next goal from the roadmap, watchdog for stalls (human 2026-10-06)
spec: Human 2026-10-06 'do those' after the Planner listed three gaps: (1) finished goals stop at 'PR pending' and nothing merges them (T-1660 held after spec review T-1666); (2) nothing files the next goal when one finishes; (3) nothing notices a dead or broken daemon: on 2026-10-06 work stalled ~11 h because the luna-inbox daemon's PATH lacked the Homebrew bin dir ('claude CLI not found on PATH') and ai-apprentice had no daemon after its headless goal Planner exited. Policy: merges to main need no human approval when checks pass and a rollback exists (decisions.md 2026-10-06).
acceptance: a finished goal reaches main unattended with a recorded rollback
a closed goal leads to the next roadmap goal being filed
a dead daemon or stalled queue is restarted or reported within 15 minutes

result.summary: Goal complete: ship v2 (T-1678 + fix rounds T-1681/T-1683), watchdog + claude CLI resolver (T-1679 + fix T-1682) and next_goal (T-1699 lineage) merged into goal/T-1667 and shipped as PR 44 (1c72a58, merged 2026-10-07 00:42Z under the 2026-10-06 policy). origin/goal/T-1667 has 0 commits not in main (main is 25 ahead). Open children are all superseded (T-1668/69/70/73/74/75/80/89/95 respecs and a conflict round). Follow-ups from the final verification went to goal T-1703 and first-night fixes to T-1705 (PRs 46, 47). No new PR needed. Closed on the bus 2026-10-09 by the headless decision Planner; [ship].enabled is still false (off since 2026-10-07 until ship ignores goals closed before it was enabled), so ship must not re-gate or roll this goal back.
